hero_description: Dr. Kumbhare completed his FNB fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery at Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram. He works across general, gastrointestinal and laparoscopic surgery.
about_short: Dr. Krunal Kumbhare is a general and laparoscopic surgeon in Nagpur. He completed an FNB fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery at Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram, after working as a senior resident in Pune and Nagpur.
about_long: His surgical experience includes elective, emergency and trauma cases. At Fortis, his training covered advanced laparoscopy, single-incision techniques, bariatric perioperative care and exposure to robotic GI, colorectal and abdominal wall procedures. He has also worked in surgical wards, ICUs and operating theatres and taught undergraduate medical students.

care_areas.title: Laparoscopic Surgery
care_areas.description: Keyhole procedures for gallstones, appendicitis and selected abdominal conditions. Smaller incisions may mean less discomfort and a more comfortable recovery.

care_areas.title: GI & Hepatobiliary Surgery
care_areas.description: Surgical assessment for digestive tract, gallbladder, liver and colorectal conditions, using open or minimally invasive approaches when appropriate.

care_areas.title: Hernia & Abdominal Wall Repair
care_areas.description: Assessment and repair of inguinal, umbilical and incisional hernias. More complex or recurrent defects may need abdominal wall reconstruction.

care_areas.title: Single-Incision Surgery (SILS)
care_areas.description: For selected procedures, including some gallbladder operations, a single incision near the navel may be an option. Suitability depends on the case.

care_areas.title: Laser Proctology
care_areas.description: Evaluation of piles, anal fissures and fistulas, with laser-based treatment considered when clinically suitable. The right treatment depends on the diagnosis.

care_areas.title: General & Emergency Surgery
care_areas.description: Surgical assessment for acute abdominal conditions, trauma, soft-tissue swellings and abscesses, informed by hospital, operating-theatre and ICU experience.
